selection.policy: first 2N samples per split in the pre-prediction data manifest, paired consecutively without shuffling

gradient_target: All 50.7M trainable SSR parameters, with Base/2D Head frozen and detached; objectives are summed over K=1..3 exactly as the refined training term.

module_modes.ssr: train with BatchNorm using current two-image batch statistics
module_modes.batch_norm_buffers: restored to checkpoint state before every batch and after audit

gradient_accumulation: Effective-batch tables are the exact vector average of all two-image microbatch gradients in each split.
